Name: Horse Friendly Meadowlands Bridge
Author: fireredlily
Description:
Playing on the Meadowlands map and want to be able to ride your horse up to Grandpa's shrine? This mod changes the existing one plank bridge to a 2-wide plank bridge so that horses can fit through it.

This mod requires SDV 1.6, as it specifically patches the new Meadowlands/Ranching farm map added in SDV 1.6.
